page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head at the top and the page number 330 at the top left. Below the text: a dated closing line, a centred letter heading, a summary line, the salutation, and the opening of a letter with a large initial. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: nimo sedet immotus verus hic & praecla-rus versiculus, καλλιςόν ἐςι χρῆμα παι-δείας βροτοῖς. Verum Epistolii modus illius laudibus finem imponere cogit, qvi de litteris, litteratisqve omnibus be-ne merendi finem nunquam facit. Unum mihi superest, ut qva sum in te observan-tia & obseqvio, in haec vota precesqve non cessem; te, tuamqve dignitatem ad Ecclesiae salutem, Deus Opt. Max. & conservet diutissime, & meritis honori-bus augeat, cumuletqve qvam citisime. Vale, Reverendisime Praesul, & me tui observantissimum amare perge.
main_text.head: EPIST. XL.
R. Goesaldus J. Morino, quod praeter al-lata notent Romani Aulici in ejus Libro De la Grandeur, &c. scribit.
main_text.p: LA Grace de Jesus pour jamais. J'ay donné vostre lettre à Monseigneur Suarez.

page.notes: The Greek words are copied as printed; the accents and the final letters of καλλιςόν and ἐςι are read from a small scan and could not be fully confirmed. The summary line under EPIST. XL. is set in roman type and is treated as a level 2 heading. The letter continues on the next page.
